scale.1: Very weak - serious problem, little or no evidence
scale.3: Okay - some evidence, open questions remain
scale.5: Very strong - clear evidence from several sources

rules: Every score must name at least one framework from this file.
Every score must cite evidence (transcript quote, source link, or marked [ASSUMPTION]).
Run GUCCI first; its answers feed the criteria listed in feeds_from_gucci.

criteria.name: Customer need
criteria.question: Is the problem real, frequent, and painful?

criteria.name: Competitors
criteria.question: Who else solves this, and how are we different?

criteria.name: Value
criteria.question: What pains do we remove and gains do we create?

criteria.name: Usability
criteria.question: Can people figure it out and keep coming back?

criteria.name: Feasibility
criteria.question: Can we build it with our skills, data, time and money?

criteria.name: Viability
criteria.question: Can it make money and grow?

criteria.name: Ethics / Responsible AI
criteria.question: Is it fair, safe, honest, and private?

criteria.name: Wow factor
criteria.question: Is there a magic moment users will talk about?

criteria.name: AI-fit
criteria.question: Does this truly need AI, or would a simple rule work?

criteria.name: Defensibility
criteria.question: What stops a big company from copying this next month?

verdict.pivot: Everything in between (fix the weak criteria, then re-score)
